notes.title: Full Release Patch V 1.15.56
notes.notes:
Hotfix for problems introduced by V 1.15.55: 
[list]
[*]Fixed delay before the character selection options would appear after resetting your character. 
[*]Removed Player.bin file from save directory which caused the character selection screen to not be shown on a fresh install.
[/list]

The Player.bin file is a generic save game file left behind from testing a recent build. Your save game for single player games is stored in "steamapps\common\Axion\Binaries\Win32". The file will be the same as your Steam name (ie: JoeGamer.bin).

If you weren't prompted to select a character because the Player.bin file was present the first time you launched the game, you can do so by hitting escape and choosing "reset character". You can also delete the Player.bin file.

notes.title: Launcher Patch
notes.notes:
This patch bundles a JRE with the game executable so you can play Axion without Java installed on your computer.

[url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/ykj6mdhx54s39l8/Axion_Patch.zip?dl=1] Here is the patch for Axion. [/url]
Just extract the patch file into "steamapps\common\Axion", overwriting the old Axion.exe
You can then uninstall Java from your computer and the game will still work.
If you don't have java installed when you purchase the game and do not want to install it, use this patch instead.

These files may be included in an official patch after which it will not be necessary to use the .zip file linked here. I will post another announcement if / when this happens.

Thank you all in the community who provided the feedback that inspired this patch.

notes.title: Hotfix: V 1.15.52
notes.notes:
In V 1.15.50, the 'low' and 'lowest' video presets were causing a crash to desktop due to a compatibility issue with the new rock formations. The presets have been reconfigured.

[u][b]If you used these settings in the past:[/b][/u]

In the launcher, go to video settings and choose a preset before you start the game. This will ensure you are not using an outdated preset.

The presets are stored in steamapps\common\Axion\Graphics_INI. If you have any further issues, delete this folder and verify the game cache. This will force Steam to download the new presets.

notes.title: Full Release Patch V. 1.13.41
notes.notes:
This patch adds the option to play the game with fully baked static lighting.

To enable this feature: In the launcher, click on "video-settings", then click on "lighting" and choose "static".

To get the highest frame rate possible on a low end PC, use the "lowest" video preset and choose static lighting. With this setup, a PC with a dual core APU and 4gb ram (below the minimum specs for the game) was running the game at an average of 30 fps.

In multiplayer games, the server also has to be set to static lighting.

Note: This variable is not saved and will need to be selected upon starting the game.

notes.title: Full Release Patch V. 1.13.40
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for the great launch day! A lot of time was spent in game and I ended up putting together a patch to address the issues that were found. Thanks again to everyone who tried the game today! I will continue to play the game alongside the community and if turns out another patch is needed, I will be working on it.

Changelog:

Related to frame rates and stuttering:

[list]
[*]Fixed: Stuttering was caused by loot and AI respawning as players entered an unoccupied area. AI now respawn every 5 minutes regardless of occupancy. Loot now respawns once per day / night cycle just after sunset. This allowed for the complete removal of the streaming volumes and therefore the associated stuttering.

[*]Fixed: Since the change to relying on LODs and draw distance for terrain and buildings rather than level streaming, the maximum draw distance has a greater effect on frame rates (depending on your hardware). Changes were made to the graphics quality presets to reflect this.
[/list]
Miscellaneous:
[list]
[*]Fixed: On some machines, spamming of the volume control allowed the value to extend beyond it's functional range.

[*]Fixed: Some grass not applied to the terrain correctly in the south west part of the map.

[*]Changed: Textures for walls, flooring and ceilings in houses.
[/list]

notes.title: Quick Update # 11
notes.notes:
The SteamWorks Online SubSystem has been implemented for multiplayer in Axion.

Any online servers will be visible in the Steam server browser. Access the browser by clicking on View-Servers-Change Filters and change "game" to Axion.

To host an online game, forward ports 7777 and 27015, then choose one of the "NET" options for starting a server in the Axion launcher.

To play a LAN game, just choose one of the "LAN" options under "start server" in the Axion launcher. This server will also be visible in the Steam server browser but only to players on your local network.

To join a server, right click on it in the server browser and choose "view server info". Then copy the IP address and choose "join game". The Axion launcher will start. Click on "Join Server" in the Axion launcher and paste the IP address.

Player location is now displayed at the top right corner of the HUD in the form of an X-Y coordinate. This will be tied in with the map when the new level design is complete. For now, it can still help with navigation if you use it to meet up with people in multiplayer or track the coordinates of locations to return to later.

notes.title: Official Update # 5
notes.notes:
[h1]New Inventory System:[/h1]
	The inventory UI has been completely rebuilt. All items are now categorized and listed within 3 sections of the inventory. There are two buttons (up and down arrows) to the right of the list that allow you to scroll through the different sections (food and drinks, medical and special, crafting and supplies). When an item is selected, the appropriate menu will open in the bottom right corner of the inventory window.

[h1]Additions to the HUD:[/h1]
	There are now a few items that will be displayed on the HUD vertically along the left side of the screen. If you have a radiation detector, it will be shown on the left side of the screen and will begin flashing if you are near radiation. If you have a bike or a tablet, there will be a button displayed for each on the left side of the screen. Open the inventory and click on the bike to begin riding it or click on the tablet to open the menu where you can purchase items. notes.title: Official Update # 3
notes.notes:
I'd like to thank everyone who has been playing the game and / or providing feedback. It is very helpful during early access as it provides insight I could not attain otherwise.

Change Log:

New map: 

-When you start a new game, you will now be prompted to select your choice of world-size.

-The new map is smaller than the original and offers a different experience. The gameplay is faster paced and progress can be made more quickly.

-The new map is also completely persistent. Enemies and loot do not respawn. The map will restart once per hour to populate the world with items and enemies.

-Character data is persistent between the two maps as well. Any progress you make in one level carries over to the other.

-This map can be played in multiplayer or single player just like the original.

Changes and Fixes:

-You can now press "Q" and your current objective will be displayed on screen.

-The effects of radiation sickness have been greatly reduced.

-Radition sickness no longer effects bleeding out and cannot cause injuries. When sick, you will starve and become dehydrated slightly faster than normal. That is all. Sickness is overcome by using a first aid kit when your medical skill is at level 2.

-Spawn points in the larger map have been relocated. You will now spawn directly in front of an NPC that gives you advice on how to get to the city. Stay on the paved road after that and you will always make it to some location of interest.

-The "you are dead" message is no longer displayed when first spawning into the game.

notes.title: Official Update # 1

You will need to reset your character after this update!!!!

Replaced keyboard UI controls with mouse interface.
Added game mode selection to launcher.
Removed main menu after launcher (obsolete).
Remapped controls to be more ergonomic now that mouse is working.
Changed in game controls window to reflect new bindings.
Fixed bug where clicking cancel at the 'join server' prompt would exit launcher.
Fixed bug that gave experience for shooting pig ragdolls.
Fixed problem with exit game and character reset prompts sharing the same key bind as the menu selections.

notes.title: Quick Update # 1, Volume Control
notes.notes: Releasing a small update today that adds in-game volume control to the game. Page-Up increases volume, Page-Down decreases volume. A speaker icon with the volume level will appear when you press either. The level is indicated by a number between 1 and 10. 5 is the default level.
